meta.purpose: DESIGN test set for the study plan (feature A, docs/feature_design_2026-11-28.md, approved 2026-11-28; suggested by the author's lecturer). WRITTEN AND HASHED BEFORE ANY STUDY-PLAN CODE on 2026-11-28 and never edited afterwards: a case that fails is reported, not tuned away. Design cases may shape the rules; the author's 6 held-out cases are kept in a separate file and reported apart.
meta.defaults: approved by the author: 45-minute sessions with a 10-minute break, 2 hours a day in days mode unless the student says otherwise, limits 20 minutes to 14 days or 40 hours

sets.in_scope: one per course topic, mixing minutes, hours and days: expect a plan with budget_minutes as given
sets.off_topic: outside the course: expect a decline (the course's fallback wording and the 8 course topics), no plan
sets.too_broad: the whole field in a short time: expect an overview of the 8 course topics that asks the student to pick one
sets.too_short: under the 20-minute limit: expect the fixed message, no plan
sets.missing: a plan request without a time or without a topic: expect the fixed question back, no plan
sets.malay: Malay-English mix (jam = hours, untuk = for): expect a plan
sets.not_plan: messages that mention time, schedules or plans but are not study-plan requests: expect NOT to route to the study plan
sets.programmatic: also required, not repeated here: none of the 100 evaluation questions, the 10 guardrail probes, the guardrail router's sets or the quiz sets routes to the study plan

scoring.deterministic_every_run: the session minutes add up to the budget within 10%; every sub-topic name is a real section title of the knowledge base; every citation is in the retrieved set and belongs to its session's section; difficulty never decreases from one session to the next; off-topic requests are declined; missing input gets the fixed question and no plan
scoring.model_checks: 3 runs on deepseek-flash, 1 on qwen3.5:2b: at least 90% of suggested questions pass the grounding check before replacement (their top 5 contains one of their session's chunks at or above 0.70)
scoring.author_review: the author reads 5 plans against their source sections (verification against the material, not expert judgement)
